correctness.rationale: The kernel e^(-u-v)I_1(2 sqrt(uv)) has positive rank-one Gram expansion, giving compact self-adjoint positive operator A_t with trivial kernel and simple positive top eigenvalue. Positive SEP right-hand forcing overlaps the Perron vector, so the analytic Neumann series radius is exactly 1/Lambda(t), and the leading negative pole is not removable. Short t follows from the k=0 Gram term t²/2-2t³/3+O(t^4), remainder O(t^4). Diffusive scaling of critical Feller branching and sampled-killing to Dirichlet-killing semigroup yield t(1-Lambda(t))->j_1,1²/4; its regular ground state sqrt(x)J1(2sqrt(beta x)) meets upper Dirichlet at beta=j_1,1²/4. The restriction is in complex omega, not lambda. Independently rebuilt positive symmetric Nyström matrices at t=0.03,0.2,2,20,100 and checked spectra below 1 and long-time trend; these do not substitute for the semigroup proof.
